name: readme-craft
description: Generate a standardized, human-sounding, GFM-compliant README.md, using AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md as extra context when present. Auto-generates a matching SVG banner for the top of the README whenever the environment can produce images (hand-written SVG always works). For web-app and tutorial projects it can also drive a browser to capture real UI screenshots and embed them in the README.
